We now prove Thrm. 4.2 by comparing the two constructions of CAOS : the leave-one-out calibrated prediction set defined in Eqn. 16 and the theoretical full conformal construction defined in Eqn. 22 . The proof leverages the conformal validity of full CAOS via two steps: (i) a monotonicity lemma showing that the CAOS nonconformity scores can only improve as the reference set grows, and (ii) a comparison lemma relating leave-one-out CAOS scores to their full conformal analogues.
